_doc: Chinese line text for Chinese mode -> web/data/scene_lines_zh.json (existing zh text is kept). Fill zh; leave en as reference. Speaker names in zh mode: 豆丁 / Wendy / Kai.

C1_s01.speaker: wendy
C1_s01.en: Whoa! I got a star! What did I do?

C1_s01.speaker: dingo
C1_s01.en: You put an onion in the pot. Stars tell you 'that was good, do it again!'

C1_s02.speaker: kai
C1_s02.en: Um... so if I want more stars, I do more of that?

C2_s01.speaker: kai
C2_s01.en: I always go this way. It's... a long way, but I know it.

C2_s01.speaker: wendy
C2_s01.en: Ooh, what's that? I found a shortcut!

C2_s02.speaker: dingo
C2_s02.en: Trying something new is called exploring. Sometimes it's a mess, sometimes you find something better.

C3_s01.speaker: dingo
C3_s01.en: After lots of practice, they have a plan in their heads. That's their strategy.

C3_s01.speaker: wendy
C3_s01.en: I know where to go every time!

C3_s02.speaker: kai
C3_s02.en: Um... I'm sure about the onions, but not the plates yet.

C3_s02.speaker: dingo
C3_s02.en: The clearer the bubble, the surer they are.

L0_s01.speaker: dingo
L0_s01.en: Welcome to my kitchen! Have you ever made onion soup? Let's make one together.

L0_s03.speaker: dingo
L0_s03.en: Now drop it in the pot.

L0_s04.speaker: dingo
L0_s04.en: Let it cook for a bit.

L0_s07.speaker: dingo
L0_s07.en: You did it! That's a perfect bowl. You're officially a Soup Master!

L0_s08.speaker: wendy
L0_s08.en: Hi! I'm Wendy, nice to meet you! Ooh, is that soup? It smells amazing!

L0_s08.speaker: kai
L0_s08.en: Um... hello. I'm Kai. We're new here... could you show us how to make soup?

L0_s09.speaker: dingo
L0_s09.en: They're my new apprentices. They can't learn just by watching. They learn from stars. Every time they do a step right, you give them a star. Will you teach them?

L1_s01.speaker: dingo
L1_s01.en: Pick the steps that deserve a star, then press Train.

L1_s02.speaker: wendy
L1_s02.en: Onions! More onions! I love onions!

L1_s02.speaker: kai
L1_s02.en: Um... I think we have too many onions...

L1_s02.speaker: kai
L1_s02.en: I want a star... but how do I get one?

L1_s03.speaker: dingo
L1_s03.en: It took them a long time to find their first star.

L1_s04.speaker: dingo
L1_s04.en: See? They learn whatever you reward. Nice work!

L2_s01.speaker: wendy
L2_s01.en: I know you gave me stars for soup... but what's over there? I just have to check!

L2_s02.speaker: dingo
L2_s02.en: They're very curious. Try turning their curiosity up or down.

L2_s03.speaker: kai
L2_s03.en: Um... I'll just stay here. I don't want to try anything new.

L2_s04.speaker: dingo
L2_s04.en: If they never try anything, they never find a star.

L2_s05.speaker: dingo
L2_s05.en: A little curious at first, then focused. That's how they find the best path. Trying lots of things at the start really helps!

L3_s01.speaker: dingo
L3_s01.en: Wow, you taught them well. Ready for the soup contest? First, how sure are you that we'll win?

L3_s02.speaker: dingo
L3_s02.en: Now let's ask Wendy and Kai.

L3_s02.speaker: wendy
L3_s02.en: Totally! I know exactly where the onions are!

L3_s02.speaker: kai
L3_s02.en: Um... I'm not so sure about the plates...

L4_s01.speaker: dingo
L4_s01.en: Here's a secret: nobody can make soup alone in this kitchen. You two have to work together!

L4_s01.speaker: dingo
L4_s01.en: You'll play as Wendy. Kai is counting on you. Ready... cook!

L4_s03.speaker: kai
L4_s03.en: Um... that was hard. I'll do my best next time.

L4_s03.speaker: wendy
L4_s03.en: Let's try again! I know we can do it!

L4_s04.speaker: dingo
L4_s04.en: Two bowls wins. You're so close!

recap_L0_s01.speaker: dingo
recap_L0_s01.en: Remember our very first soup? Onions, pot, cook, plate, serve!

recap_L0_s01.speaker: dingo
recap_L0_s01.en: In AI words, the cook is the agent. The kitchen is the environment.

recap_L0_s02.speaker: dingo
recap_L0_s02.en: Each moment in the kitchen is a state. Each move you pick is an action.

recap_L0_s02.speaker: wendy
recap_L0_s02.en: And the right order of actions makes the soup!

recap_L1_s01.speaker: wendy
recap_L1_s01.en: Level one was all about rewards! A reward is like a gold star.

recap_L1_s01.speaker: wendy
recap_L1_s01.en: When I only got stars for onions, I just piled up onions. Zero soup!

recap_L1_s02.speaker: wendy
recap_L1_s02.en: So reward design matters. You learn what you get rewarded for.

recap_L1_s02.speaker: kai
recap_L1_s02.en: Good rewards, like small stars for each helpful step, taught us much faster.

recap_L2_s01.speaker: kai
recap_L2_s01.en: Level two was about exploring. It means trying new things.

recap_L2_s01.speaker: kai
recap_L2_s01.en: With zero curiosity, we kept bumping into walls. No soup at all.

recap_L2_s02.speaker: kai
recap_L2_s02.en: So at first, try a lot. Later, use what works best. That's exploitation.

recap_L2_s02.speaker: wendy
recap_L2_s02.en: Trying, and trying again, is how we learned. That's training!

recap_L3_s01.speaker: dingo
recap_L3_s01.en: Level three asked a big question: is the AI sure?

recap_L3_s01.speaker: dingo
recap_L3_s01.en: Each action has a value. That's a guess of how good it will be.

recap_L3_s02.speaker: dingo
recap_L3_s02.en: Solid bubbles meant sure. Dashed bubbles meant not so sure.

recap_L3_s02.speaker: kai
recap_L3_s02.en: If our confidence is low, don't trust us too much. Think for yourself!

recap_L4_s01.speaker: wendy
recap_L4_s01.en: Level four was teamwork! You played me, and Kai cooked beside you.

recap_L4_s01.speaker: wendy
recap_L4_s01.en: Two agents working together is called multi-agent cooperation.

recap_L4_s02.speaker: wendy
recap_L4_s02.en: The team score is my score plus Kai's score, added up.

recap_L4_s02.speaker: kai
recap_L4_s02.en: Sometimes you get fewer stars, but the team does better. That's okay.

recap_L4_s03.speaker: dingo
recap_L4_s03.en: Now you know how AI learns. Great job, little chefs!

story_s01.speaker: dingo
story_s01.en: Well hello there, friend! Welcome, welcome!

story_s01.speaker: dingo
story_s01.en: I'm Dingo, head chef of this little kitchen. What's your name?

story_s02.speaker: dingo
story_s02.en: What a great name, friend. So happy to meet you!

story_s03.speaker: dingo
story_s03.en: Today's a big day. My two little apprentices are learning to cook, and I need a helper. That's you!

story_s04.speaker: dingo
story_s04.en: Let's make some yummy onion soup together. Ready? Follow me!

trans_s01.speaker: dingo
trans_s01.en: Nice work, friend! Now Wendy's turn. Can you teach her with stars?

trans_s02.speaker: dingo
trans_s02.en: Wendy's learning! But Kai never wants to try new things... let's help him explore.

trans_s03.speaker: dingo
trans_s03.en: Curious cooks find new tricks! Now, how sure are they about their moves?

trans_s04.speaker: dingo
trans_s04.en: They're almost real chefs! Time for the big soup contest. Let's go!
